caption: The drawing consists of a central arrangement of five diamond-shaped patterns, each with distinct printed textile designs in colors such as red, beige, brown, black, blue, and purple. The upper left and right corners of the drawing each feature a square containing two red flowers with green stems and leaves, with the right square also including a blue and yellow striped vase at the base of the stems. The central diamond at the top features a red background with white and black floral motifs. The left central diamond has a beige background with a multicolored floral pattern, including blue, red, and green, while the right central diamond has a cream background with black and red floral designs. The bottom left diamond features a white background with brown geometric and floral motifs, and the bottom right diamond has a brown background with a grid of small red, white, and black shapes. The center bottom diamond is light purple with a faint geometric pattern. The objects are arranged on a light beige rectangular background, with lines faintly marking off the sections. There is cursive text at the bottom, reading "Westchester County" on the left and "Drawn by W.P. Sherwood" on the right.
title: Printed Quilt Patterns
